card.name: Words of warning and caution
card.fires_on: Words that give a warning or caution, such as warn, warned, warning, cautionary notes, or an appeal for calm. It fires on the warning word itself or just before the warned-about content.

modes.label: Warning words
modes.description: The verb or noun for warning, in label text or news reports.
modes.example: medical experts have<< warned>> in a new report

modes.label: Words leading into a warning
modes.description: A word that introduces a caution or appeal, such as notes, for, or to.
modes.example: issues cautionary<< notes>>. “They do not typically work well

modes.label: Warning heading
modes.description: The word after a Warning heading that introduces advice to patients.
modes.example: Warning<< to>> the Patient All patients should be warned that

card.writes: It pushes the model toward warn and caution words, including Chinese ones for warning and reminding.
card.plain: It lights up when the text is cautioning or warning someone about a risk.
